# Axiomwriter

> AI-powered writing intelligence platform for fiction authors. Manage your manuscript, characters, lore bible, and plot threads — all in sync.

Axiomwriter is built for fiction writers managing novels and series. It is not a generic notes app or document editor. The core value proposition is that your world bible and your manuscript stay in sync — AI that understands your specific world, characters, and voice, not just grammar and spelling.

## What Axiomwriter Does

- **Manuscript Editor**: Chapter and scene structure with inline AI writing assistance (Composer Mode)
- **Character Profiles**: Full character sheets with Voice DNA — speech patterns, vocabulary level, recurring phrases — so AI writes each character in their own voice
- **Lore Bible**: World-building database with AI consistency checking across entries and scenes
- **Plot Thread Tracker**: Narrative threads that span chapters, tracked by status (active, resolved, seeded)
- **World Map Builder**: Visual geography tool for your fictional world
- **Book Cover Studio**: AI-assisted cover design and generation
- **Publishing Export**: Export to EPUB, DOCX, PDF formats compatible with KDP and IngramSpark
- **Series Architecture**: Multi-book continuity tracking and series management
- **Beta Reader Sharing**: Share drafts with readers for feedback

## Who It's For

Fiction writers at any experience level, any genre. Primary use case: authors managing multiple active projects — novels, series, worldbuilding documents, and character sheets — simultaneously.

## Pricing

- **Free**: 1 project, basic character and lore tracking, no AI assists, no export
- **Writer ($9/month)**: Unlimited projects, AI writing assistance, standard exports
- **Composer ($19/month)**: Everything in Writer plus Composer Mode, World Map, Cover Studio
- **Architect ($39/month)**: Everything in Composer plus series architecture, beta reader sharing, priority support

## Technical Context

- Web application (SPA) available at axiomwriter.com
- Progressive Web App — installable on iOS, Android, and desktop
- Built by Stacked Alchemist LLC (stackedalchemist.dev)
- AI features powered by Claude (Anthropic)
